name: CSG and Inter-object Intersection
definition: Performs general Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) by voxelizing each object in a separate slicemap, rendering one over the other with blending for the desired boolean operation.
summary: CSG and Inter-object Intersection performs boolean operations by voxelizing objects into slicemaps and blending them, differing by leveraging solid voxelization to rapidly recover intersection volumes for collision detection.
